scoring_justification: Bandgap values are compared to paper‑reported golds (T0); CBM/VBM internal consistency is recomputed from both artifacts (T1); zero‑strain straddle is a structural check (T3). The combination verifies the main claims.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for bandgap ranges and specific strain points, used for result‑level comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text (Section 3, Fig. 7 discussion). HPSi range 1.628–2.056 eV; HSiP at η=8,9,10% values 3.111,2.857,2.613 eV, compression range 1.866–3.136 eV; HSiPbp compression range 1.862–3.129 eV, tensile range 2.556–3.117 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own published numeric results, not invented.

outputs.description: Bandgap vs strain data for the three monolayer H-Si-P structures, used to verify the bandgap ranges and trends reported in the paper.
Absolute band edge positions (CBM and VBM) vs strain, used to verify alignment with water redox potentials and strain-tunability.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare selected values and trends against the paper's reported data with appropriate tolerances. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed here.
